name: HBM & advanced packaging
inclusion_rule: Manufacture HBM devices or provide advanced package integration explicitly used for dense chip interconnect; record the actual role separately.
exclusion_rule: Using purchased HBM in a GPU, generic DRAM supply, or owning packaging equipment alone does not establish both roles.
granular_facets: HBM device generation; interposer/chiplet integration; outsourced packaging; process-tool adjacency
measurement_hold: D03 split review; do not measure device makers and packaging suppliers as one homogeneous cohort.

name: GPUs & merchant accelerators
inclusion_rule: Design and supply merchant accelerator silicon or systems with a specifically identified accelerator product.
exclusion_rule: Cloud rental, component use, an internal-only ASIC, or a generic AI mention is not merchant accelerator manufacture.
granular_facets: GPU architecture; merchant accelerator; board/system integration; software ecosystem
measurement_hold: Issuer aggregation must avoid counting one supplier's chip and complete system as independent members.

name: AI cluster interconnect silicon
inclusion_rule: Supply identified switch, NIC, interconnect or optical-interface semiconductor products used in cluster connectivity.
exclusion_rule: Fiber manufacture, optical cabling, data-center operation or generic communications revenue alone is insufficient.
granular_facets: Switch ASIC; NIC/DPU; optical DSP; retimer; optical engine interface
measurement_hold: D04 scope review: optical devices and switch/NIC silicon may need distinct cohorts; keep facets before node changes.

name: Custom ASIC accelerators
inclusion_rule: Provide customer-specific accelerator design or silicon-development capability with a named program or bounded official product description.
exclusion_rule: Merchant GPUs, an unconfirmed customer rumor or generic outsourced foundry capacity is not a custom accelerator design mandate.
granular_facets: Design services; custom compute die; chiplet integration; customer-owned design
measurement_hold: Confidential customers and undisclosed program revenue remain unknown; commercial architecture is not a won shipment.

name: Conventional DRAM (non-HBM)
inclusion_rule: Produce non-HBM DRAM such as DDR/LPDDR with a current product family.
exclusion_rule: HBM-only evidence, memory-module assembly without DRAM production, and NAND are excluded.
granular_facets: DDR; LPDDR; server DRAM; mobile DRAM; module versus die
measurement_hold: A consolidated DRAM revenue line that includes HBM is not a clean non-HBM numerator.

name: NAND & enterprise storage
inclusion_rule: Produce NAND flash or identified enterprise NAND storage products, with die maker, controller, module and system roles distinguished.
exclusion_rule: Hard-disk-only business, DRAM, generic cloud storage and pre-separation corporate rosters are insufficient.
granular_facets: NAND die; enterprise SSD; controller; module/system; manufacturing joint venture
measurement_hold: Corporate separations and shared joint ventures require dated entity lineage and overlap checks.

name: Lithography tools
inclusion_rule: Supply lithographic exposure or directly identified lithography-process systems; state the exact process role.
exclusion_rule: A resist coating/development supplier must not be labeled an EUV exposure-scanner maker.
granular_facets: EUV scanner; DUV scanner; coat/develop; process control adjacency
measurement_hold: Separate exposure tools from tracks and consumables before any process-specific measurement.

name: Etch & deposition equipment
inclusion_rule: Supply identified semiconductor etch or deposition process equipment.
exclusion_rule: Making chips, supplying generic factory tools or supplying only a subsystem does not establish complete process-equipment manufacture.
granular_facets: Etch; CVD; ALD; PVD; process generation; installed service
measurement_hold: Process and installed-base exposure differ; tool availability alone does not establish customer capex sensitivity.

name: Process metrology & inspection
inclusion_rule: Provide wafer, mask or package process inspection/metrology systems with an identified measurement function.
exclusion_rule: Machine vision for general automation and chip fabrication itself are not automatically semiconductor process metrology.
granular_facets: Optical inspection; e-beam inspection; thin-film metrology; defect review; software
measurement_hold: Age product evidence explicitly; vendor performance claims are not independently established market share.

name: Wafer-fab subsystems & components
inclusion_rule: Provide identifiable process-control, vacuum, gas-delivery, power or motion subsystems used in wafer fabrication.
exclusion_rule: A broad industrial component sold somewhere in electronics without wafer-fab use evidence is insufficient.
granular_facets: RF/power delivery; vacuum; gas/pressure control; motion; service parts
measurement_hold: Subcomponent roles must not be promoted to full etch/deposition-tool membership.

name: Liquid cooling & thermal management
inclusion_rule: Provide a named liquid-cooling, coolant-distribution or thermal-management product/service for computing infrastructure.
exclusion_rule: Conventional building HVAC, a cooling customer or a announced capacity plan alone is not current liquid-cooling supply.
granular_facets: Cold plate; coolant distribution unit; immersion; facility loop; service
measurement_hold: Separate product offering, customer deployment and revenue materiality.

name: HV transformers & switchgear
inclusion_rule: Supply identified high-voltage transformers or switchgear; retain voltage class and product type.
exclusion_rule: Medium-voltage distribution switchgear or UPS evidence alone must not silently satisfy a high-voltage-transformer definition.
granular_facets: HV transformer; HV switchgear; MV adjacency; service; grid versus facility
measurement_hold: D06 boundary review is required for MV-only candidates; two parents do not double the issuer.

name: UPS & power conversion
inclusion_rule: Provide identified uninterruptible power supplies or power-conversion products for critical electrical loads.
exclusion_rule: Batteries alone, grid-generation equipment or generic switchgear does not prove a UPS product.
granular_facets: UPS topology; power converter; facility scale; rack scale; backup storage interface
measurement_hold: Product presence is descriptive membership evidence, not a measured data-center revenue share.

name: Reactor technology
inclusion_rule: Own or supply a specific reactor design or technology with official development, approval or deployment evidence.
exclusion_rule: Design approval is not an operating plant, electricity generation or realized project revenue.
granular_facets: Design developer; design approval; licensing; construction; operating deployment
measurement_hold: Development and operating cohorts must be separate; project-stage evidence expires at material change.

name: Nuclear components
inclusion_rule: Supply components, services or manufacturing specifically identified for nuclear facilities or propulsion programs.
exclusion_rule: Generic metal fabrication or an undifferentiated industrial backlog is insufficient.
granular_facets: Pressure components; specialized manufacturing; maintenance; acquired capability
measurement_hold: Business ownership must use transaction closing, not only announcement.

name: Fuel cycle
inclusion_rule: Perform an evidenced stage of uranium mining, conversion, enrichment, fuel fabrication or related fuel services.
exclusion_rule: All stages cannot be inferred from one uranium exposure, proposed mine or future offtake.
granular_facets: Mining; conversion; enrichment; HALEU; fabrication; services
measurement_hold: D07 stage split review; contracted future volume is not delivered output.

name: Grid distribution automation
inclusion_rule: Provide named distribution-grid automation, protection, control or monitoring products.
exclusion_rule: Generic enterprise software, grid assets or a discontinued product page alone is insufficient.
granular_facets: Distribution control; protection; substation monitoring; software; hardware
measurement_hold: Use current replacements and retire discontinued products without rewriting historical evidence.

name: Transmission & HVDC cabling
inclusion_rule: Provide identified high-voltage transmission or HVDC cable systems and related installation capability.
exclusion_rule: Ordinary building wire or low-voltage connectivity alone is insufficient.
granular_facets: HVDC; HVAC; subsea; underground; installation/service
measurement_hold: A contract supports a project role; output and revenue follow their own realization clocks.

name: Endpoint security
inclusion_rule: Supply an identified endpoint protection, detection or response product.
exclusion_rule: An enterprise IT service or cloud-security claim alone does not establish endpoint capability.
granular_facets: Prevention; EDR; managed response; endpoint identity
measurement_hold: Overlapping platform modules are one issuer and should not create duplicated factor observations.

name: Network security
inclusion_rule: Supply identifiable network protection, firewall or network threat-management products.
exclusion_rule: Cloud hosting, general networking equipment or IAM alone is insufficient.
granular_facets: Firewall; secure access; network detection; hardware/software appliance
measurement_hold: Platform bundles need product-level evidence rather than marketing-category inheritance.

name: Identity and access management
inclusion_rule: Supply workforce/customer identity, access management or privileged access products.
exclusion_rule: A customer using identity software, or an acquired brand treated as a separate live issuer, is excluded.
granular_facets: Workforce IAM; customer IAM; privileged access; identity governance
measurement_hold: Parent, brand and listed-security lineage must be date-bound after acquisitions.

name: Cloud security
inclusion_rule: Supply identified cloud-workload, cloud-configuration or cloud-access protection capability.
exclusion_rule: Being a cloud-delivered product or cloud infrastructure vendor alone is insufficient.
granular_facets: Workload protection; posture management; cloud access; zero-trust controls
measurement_hold: Distinguish delivery model from protected workload; no transitive security membership.

name: Missiles, munitions and effects
inclusion_rule: Supply an officially identified finished defense system or associated commercial program role.
exclusion_rule: A component subcontractor or defense customer is not automatically the finished-system supplier.
granular_facets: Prime/system role; program; production/delivery; service
measurement_hold: Business-level evidence only; avoid transferring component revenue or confidential program claims.

name: Missile and munition propulsion supply
inclusion_rule: Supply explicitly identified propulsion products or manufacturing services for defense programs.
exclusion_rule: Finished-system sales alone do not prove a distinct propulsion-supply business.
granular_facets: Propulsion supplier; production expansion; acquired unit; program
measurement_hold: Capacity plans and production deliveries have separate clocks and materiality.

name: Defense sensors, electronics and C2
inclusion_rule: Provide named defense sensing, electronics, communications or command-support products.
exclusion_rule: Generic semiconductor exposure or a defense-sector label is insufficient.
granular_facets: Radar/sensing; communications; electronic systems; integration
measurement_hold: No technology performance, contract share or customer dependence is inferred from a product label.

name: Autonomy, drones and counter-UAS
inclusion_rule: Provide identified autonomous-system or counter-UAS products with an official company/program source.
exclusion_rule: Generic AI software or broad aerospace membership alone is insufficient.
granular_facets: Autonomous platform; counter-UAS; software integration; acquired product line
measurement_hold: Acquired brands remain product roles under dated issuer lineage, not extra independent members.

name: Naval and nuclear shipbuilding
inclusion_rule: Build or maintain specifically identified naval vessels or nuclear shipbuilding programs.
exclusion_rule: Equipment supplied to a shipyard is not shipbuilding.
granular_facets: Shipyard; prime/partner; construction; maintenance
measurement_hold: Joint programs require partner-role evidence and cannot be counted as two full program revenue streams.

name: Aerospace components and aftermarket
inclusion_rule: Supply identified aerospace components, replacement parts or aftermarket services.
exclusion_rule: Operating aircraft, distributing unrelated industrial parts or broad defense membership is insufficient.
granular_facets: OEM component; replacement part; maintenance; distribution
measurement_hold: Separate original equipment and recurring aftermarket exposure; broad segment totals may mix both.

name: Military space and satellite communications
inclusion_rule: Supply products or services explicitly used for military satellite/space communications.
exclusion_rule: Civil broadband alone or a general space theme is insufficient.
granular_facets: Space payload; ground system; communications service; military end use
measurement_hold: Two semantic parents do not create extra exposure weight or independent samples.

name: Machine vision
inclusion_rule: Provide identified industrial vision hardware/software for inspection, identification or guidance.
exclusion_rule: General consumer cameras and generic AI imagery do not establish industrial machine vision.
granular_facets: Vision sensor; camera; inspection software; barcode/identification
measurement_hold: Machine vision is not automatically wafer metrology or robot-arm manufacture.

name: Industrial controls and motion control
inclusion_rule: Supply identified industrial motion controllers, CNC or control systems.
exclusion_rule: A user of a controller or a motor-only offering is insufficient for the controller role.
granular_facets: CNC; motion controller; drive; system integration
measurement_hold: Controller, drive and motor roles may overlap at issuer level but are not interchangeable products.

name: Collaborative robot arms
inclusion_rule: Provide an identified collaborative robot-arm product or operating subsidiary.
exclusion_rule: A mobile robot, robot integrator or general automation label alone is insufficient.
granular_facets: Collaborative operating mode; payload/application; arm platform
measurement_hold: D08 treats collaborative mode as potentially cross-cutting; do not force a disjoint issuer cohort.

name: Industrial robot arms
inclusion_rule: Provide identified industrial articulated or other arm platforms.
exclusion_rule: Servo components, vision systems or robot customers alone are not arm suppliers.
granular_facets: Arm platform; industrial application; collaborative mode facet
measurement_hold: Overlap with collaborative arms must be disclosed, not removed through arbitrary relabeling.

name: Precision actuators and servo motors
inclusion_rule: Supply identified precision actuation or servo-motor products.
exclusion_rule: Owning a robot assembled with purchased actuators does not establish independent actuator manufacture.
granular_facets: Rotary/linear servo; precision actuator; encoder; drive interface
measurement_hold: Exclude commodity motors without precision-control evidence; unit and system revenue differ.

name: Surgical robotics systems
inclusion_rule: Supply an identified robotic surgical system.
exclusion_rule: Surgical instruments alone, a hospital customer or general industrial robots are insufficient.
granular_facets: Robotic system; instrument ecosystem; indication; installed service
measurement_hold: Multiple parents and recurring instruments must not duplicate issuer or patient/procedure observations.

name: GLP-1 incretin therapies
inclusion_rule: Develop or commercialize an identified incretin therapy, retaining molecule and regulatory stage.
exclusion_rule: API contractors, distributors or an unrelated obesity product do not automatically share the drug-owner role.
granular_facets: Molecule; mechanism; development stage; approved market
measurement_hold: Semantic pharmacology is distinct from formulation, indication and manufacturing economics.

name: Oral GLP-1 formulations
inclusion_rule: Develop or commercialize an identified oral GLP-1 product, distinguishing peptide formulation from small molecule.
exclusion_rule: Oral delivery does not imply peptide API manufacture; an injectable-only product does not qualify.
granular_facets: Oral peptide; oral small molecule; formulation; market authorization
measurement_hold: D09 facet/measurement review; avoid duplicating the same issuer and product across parent and child outcomes.

name: GLP-1 API manufacturing
inclusion_rule: Provide evidenced active-ingredient manufacturing capability or a disclosed relevant supply contract.
exclusion_rule: Confidential peptide contracts do not identify Lilly/Novo as customers; small-molecule oral drugs are not peptide API demand.
granular_facets: Peptide synthesis; small-molecule distinction; development versus commercial supply
measurement_hold: Exact drug/customer, commercial utilization and revenue share may remain unknown despite real capability.

name: Cardiorenal and metabolic indications
inclusion_rule: Associate a named therapy with a specifically sourced indication or trial, preserving approved versus investigational status.
exclusion_rule: A trial result or planned trial is not an approved indication; an indication is not a separate issuer.
granular_facets: Indication; trial stage; regulatory label; disease setting
measurement_hold: Retain as evidence facet until independent measurement substrate and owner approval exist.

name: Fill-finish and drug-delivery devices
inclusion_rule: Supply evidenced fill-finish services, primary containment or delivery devices, with the role explicit.
exclusion_rule: A glass cartridge is not the act of filling medicine; API manufacture alone is not fill-finish.
granular_facets: Fill-finish service; cartridge; syringe; injection device; planned capacity
measurement_hold: Existing sources support containment more strongly than all fill-finish roles; missing service suppliers stay a gap.

name: Launch services
inclusion_rule: Provide an officially evidenced launch service or launch vehicle operation.
exclusion_rule: A satellite customer, payload maker or mere launch booking is not a launch operator.
granular_facets: Launch provider; vehicle; mission; customer/payload boundary
measurement_hold: Launches for an Earth-observation customer do not make the launch provider an EO operator.

name: Satellite broadband services
inclusion_rule: Operate or sell a specifically evidenced satellite connectivity service.
exclusion_rule: Antenna equipment or a customer's connectivity purchase alone is insufficient.
granular_facets: Network/service operator; distribution; aviation/maritime; geographic availability
measurement_hold: A branded subsidiary/service is not automatically another current public issuer.

name: Direct-to-device satellite connectivity
inclusion_rule: Develop or operate an identified satellite-to-unmodified-device service architecture, with stage and geography.
exclusion_rule: A demonstration, launch or carrier partnership does not establish continuous commercial coverage.
granular_facets: Space segment; carrier partnership; demonstration; commercial authorization
measurement_hold: Keep demonstrators separate from operating-service metrics; no invented global subscriber exposure.

name: Earth observation
inclusion_rule: Own or supply an identified EO satellite/data product or service.
exclusion_rule: Launching someone else's EO satellite does not establish EO data ownership.
granular_facets: Satellite operator; imagery/data product; ground processing; tasking
measurement_hold: Product launch timing and actual operational availability require separate evidence.

name: Satellite ground terminals and equipment
inclusion_rule: Provide identified satellite ground networking or terminal equipment, distinguishing own design from resale.
exclusion_rule: A licensed reseller's product is not automatically manufactured by the platform supplier.
granular_facets: Hub/platform; modem; antenna; managed ground network; licensed resale
measurement_hold: Product attribution and listed-parent identity must be explicit.

name: Rare-earth separation & refining
inclusion_rule: Operate or develop specifically evidenced rare-earth separation/refining processes, retaining product stage.
exclusion_rule: Mining concentrate or mixed carbonate alone is not separated oxide; a partner's magnet output is not the company's output.
granular_facets: Mixed feed; separation; oxide; metal; recycling
measurement_hold: Separate current separated product from upstream feed and prospective expansion.

name: NdFeB permanent magnets
inclusion_rule: Manufacture or demonstrably ramp NdFeB permanent magnets, recording pilot versus commercial stage.
exclusion_rule: Rare-earth mining, magnetic precursor revenue or use of purchased magnets is insufficient for finished magnets.
granular_facets: Magnet manufacturing; metal/alloy precursor; qualification; commercial ramp
measurement_hold: A segment called Magnetics can contain precursors; no finished-magnet revenue share without a valid numerator.

name: Critical-mineral mining and development
inclusion_rule: Mine or develop a specific evidenced mineral asset; keep mineral, asset and stage explicit.
exclusion_rule: A mineral-policy mention or a downstream fabricator without mining/development evidence is insufficient.
granular_facets: Operating mine; development asset; mineral; permit/project stage
measurement_hold: An umbrella critical-mineral basket is heterogeneous; do not pool operating and speculative assets blindly.

name: Gallium and germanium supply chain
inclusion_rule: Refine, recycle or produce specifically identified gallium or germanium products, naming the element and stage.
exclusion_rule: Evidence for germanium is not evidence for gallium; a future expansion target is not current output.
granular_facets: Gallium; germanium; recovery/refining; crystal/material; recycled feed
measurement_hold: Gallium remains an explicit source gap in this packet; the combined theme must not hide that gap.

name: Copper mining
inclusion_rule: Operate or develop an evidenced copper-mining asset.
exclusion_rule: A copper refiner or cable buyer is not automatically a miner.
granular_facets: Mine; development; concentrate; by-product; restart
measurement_hold: Mine and smelter roles at one issuer require distinct evidence and no double independent N.

name: Refined copper (cathode)
inclusion_rule: Produce identified refined copper/cathode output or operate the associated refining process.
exclusion_rule: Mining concentrate alone, wire conversion or commodity resale does not establish refining.
granular_facets: Smelter; refinery; cathode; recycled versus primary feed
measurement_hold: Capacity, restarted operations and realized output are separate observations.

name: Structural steel for electrification build-out
inclusion_rule: Supply specifically evidenced steel towers, poles or structures for grid/electrification infrastructure.
exclusion_rule: An entire steelmaker's general plate or construction sales cannot be relabeled electrification exposure.
granular_facets: Transmission structures; poles; fabrication; project role
measurement_hold: A named product line supports descriptive membership, not a company-wide grid revenue percentage.

name: Copper wire and cable
inclusion_rule: Provide copper wire rod, drawn wire or cable, with processing stage and end use explicit.
exclusion_rule: Cathode production alone or a copper-intensive customer is not cable manufacture.
granular_facets: Wire rod; drawn wire; power cable; data cable; end use
measurement_hold: Feedstock-to-cable stages differ; aluminum cable must not be silently counted as copper.

name: Nitrogen fertilizer production
inclusion_rule: Manufacture identified nitrogen fertilizers or ammonia serving that production chain.
exclusion_rule: Crop retail, application machinery and fertilizer distribution alone are not production.
granular_facets: Ammonia; urea; UAN; industrial versus agricultural end use
measurement_hold: Nitrogen and low-carbon industrial ammonia have overlapping assets but distinct demand channels.

name: Potash and phosphate nutrients
inclusion_rule: Produce identified potash or phosphate nutrients with the commodity and operation explicit.
exclusion_rule: Nitrogen-only production or distribution of purchased nutrients is insufficient.
granular_facets: Potash; phosphate; mine; processing; distribution adjacency
measurement_hold: The two nutrient chains are not interchangeable; consolidated supplier totals can mix them.

name: Precision agriculture platforms
inclusion_rule: Provide evidenced precision sensing, control, software or application systems used in farming.
exclusion_rule: A generic tractor, commodity grower or chemical supplier without precision technology is insufficient.
granular_facets: Machine guidance; sensing; selective application; software/platform
measurement_hold: Technology adoption claims are not independently validated yield or earnings effects.

name: Medical imaging systems
inclusion_rule: Supply identified diagnostic medical imaging systems.
exclusion_rule: General cameras, lab instruments or a hospital user are insufficient.
granular_facets: MRI; CT; ultrasound; software; service
measurement_hold: System sales, installed service and modality economics remain distinct.

name: Remote patient monitoring
inclusion_rule: Provide a specifically evidenced patient measurement system with remote sharing/monitoring capability.
exclusion_rule: Generic telehealth distribution or an unconnected measurement device does not establish the same role.
granular_facets: Connected sensor; data-sharing platform; monitoring service; condition
measurement_hold: A glucose platform supports a bounded condition-specific role, not every remote-monitoring modality.

name: Surgical implants and instruments
inclusion_rule: Supply an identified surgical implant or instrument portfolio.
exclusion_rule: A hospital, general robotics business or device distributor alone is insufficient.
granular_facets: Implant; instrument; anatomical application; recurring consumable
measurement_hold: Product scope may overlap robotics but does not imply a robotic-system supplier.

name: Liquid biopsy assays
inclusion_rule: Provide identified blood/fluid-based cancer or other molecular assays with intended use stated.
exclusion_rule: Tissue-only tests and sequencing instruments alone are not the same assay/service.
granular_facets: Screening; therapy selection; recurrence; assay/service; specimen
measurement_hold: Regulatory and clinical claims remain test-specific; no broad efficacy conclusion.

name: Genomic sequencing (NGS)
inclusion_rule: Supply identified next-generation sequencing instruments, consumables or sequencing services with the role explicit.
exclusion_rule: A downstream test using sequencing is not automatically an instrument manufacturer.
granular_facets: Instrument; reagent/flow cell; sequencing service; downstream assay
measurement_hold: Repeated instruments, consumables and tests do not create extra independent issuer observations.

name: Proteomics discovery platforms
inclusion_rule: Supply an identified proteomics measurement/discovery platform or its validated business product.
exclusion_rule: General genomics or generic lab supplies alone are insufficient.
granular_facets: Affinity assay; mass spectrometry; discovery workflow; service
measurement_hold: Acquired platform brands belong to dated parent lineage; technology types need separate measurements.

name: Life-science laboratory instruments
inclusion_rule: Provide identified instruments for life-science laboratory measurement or analysis.
exclusion_rule: Commodity lab consumables or a clinical service using the instrument alone does not establish manufacture.
granular_facets: Mass spectrometry; analytical instrument; workflow; service
measurement_hold: This broad role can overlap proteomics; do not treat nested cohorts as independent evidence.

name: Diagnostic reagents and kits
inclusion_rule: Supply identified diagnostic reagents or kits with use and regulatory category explicit.
exclusion_rule: A research-use-only reagent cannot be assumed to be an approved clinical diagnostic.
granular_facets: Clinical chemistry; immunoassay; molecular kit; RUO versus IVD
measurement_hold: Approval and revenue are product/market specific; retain assay-level evidence.

name: Photovoltaic cell and module manufacturing
inclusion_rule: Manufacture identified photovoltaic cells or modules, retaining semiconductor chemistry and manufacturing role.
exclusion_rule: An inverter, tracker, installer or developer alone is not cell/module manufacture.
granular_facets: CdTe; crystalline silicon; cell; module; contract manufacturing
measurement_hold: CdTe module membership does not imply crystalline-silicon polysilicon input exposure.

name: Polysilicon solar feedstock
inclusion_rule: Produce identified solar-grade polysilicon feedstock.
exclusion_rule: CdTe module production, purchasing polysilicon or electronic-grade-only evidence is insufficient.
granular_facets: Solar-grade feedstock; plant; technology; listed subsidiary/parent
measurement_hold: Parent and separately listed operating subsidiary need ownership-aware aggregation, not automatic alias collapse.

name: Solar inverters
inclusion_rule: Provide identified photovoltaic inverter products.
exclusion_rule: Module manufacture, storage-only products or ownership of an installation does not establish PV inverter supply.
granular_facets: Microinverter; string inverter; central inverter; control software
measurement_hold: A proprietary internal chip does not make the inverter issuer a merchant semiconductor supplier.

name: Solar trackers & balance-of-system
inclusion_rule: Provide identified trackers or balance-of-system products, retaining mechanical/electrical roles.
exclusion_rule: PV modules, generic construction or future announced product lines are insufficient.
granular_facets: Tracker; foundation; electrical BOS; control; future PCS
measurement_hold: Rename and portfolio expansion preserve issuer identity; prospective products are not realized sales.
